summary.en: Chinese input method. Linaro's Works on WoA data lists it as working under emulation, validated by NVIDIA.
summary.zh-TW: 中文輸入法。Linaro 的 Works on WoA 資料列為以轉譯執行可運作，並經 NVIDIA 驗證。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Input methods load DLLs into other programs, so the Arm64 type matters; no vendor statement or version was found.
caveats.zh-TW: 輸入法會把 DLL 載入其他程式，Arm64 與否影響很大；未找到原廠說明或版本。
